init.title: Screen layout
init.description: Choose a layout. You can preview it before applying.

data_description.update_interval: Minimum pause between transfers, in seconds. Values update when their entities change; the clock updates once a minute. A longer pause reduces update frequency.

values.title: Display values
values.description: Choose the information to display. Empty labels and units use the entity's own name and unit.

data_description.label_1: Optional. Up to 80 characters; text fits the available space.
data_description.label_2: Optional. Up to 80 characters; text fits the available space.
data_description.unit_1: Optional. Up to 16 characters. Enter - to hide the unit.
data_description.unit_2: Optional. Up to 16 characters. Enter - to hide the unit.

preview.title: Preview screen
preview.description:
{preview}

This preview uses the current values. Apply saves the layout and sends it to the display. Edit returns to the settings; refresh updates the preview.

error.invalid_settings: Check the value and its allowed length or range.
error.invalid_entity: Display diagnostics cannot be used as a source for the screen.
